name: fence_straight_ew
note: East-west segment. Post on the west edge, two rails to the east edge, cut so they meet the next tile's west post. Closing post at the east end of a run is the same shared post (see preview). All posts are 96 px tall, 1:1 from the source. Polish: only incoming-seam pixels were changed — the east rail ends were lightened where they were near-black, and the west post's left outline is broken at the two rail bands so a preceding tile's rails meet wood rather than a hard dark bar. Overall EW look is otherwise identical.
construction: Composited at 1:1 from shared post and rail pieces extracted from the pilot fence_straight (no further scale).
